ios.desc:
Record audio the way professionals do. Meret captures lossless WAV and ALAC directly on your iPhone, then transfers files wirelessly to your Mac or PC -- no cables, no compression, no compromise.

Meret transforms your iPhone into a professional field recorder. Whether you're capturing a rehearsal, recording a podcast on location, or documenting live performances, Meret delivers studio-grade audio quality that meets professional standards.

LOSSLESS FORMATS

Record in WAV or ALAC -- the same formats used in professional studios
AAC for smaller file sizes when lossless isn't needed
Choose your sample rate: 44.1kHz, 48kHz, or 96kHz
16-bit or 24-bit depth for maximum dynamic range
ADVANCED RECORDING CONTROLS

Real-time gain adjustment with auto-gain option
3-band parametric EQ (200Hz, 1kHz, 5kHz)
High-pass and low-pass filters
Noise gate to cut unwanted background noise
All processing applied in real time during recording
SPECTRUM ANALYZER

Live frequency spectrum display alongside the VU meter
See your audio as you record it
Monitor levels and frequency content at a glance
WIRELESS TRANSFER

Send recordings directly to your Mac or PC via WiFi
No cables needed -- just connect to the same network
Fast transfers that preserve every bit of audio data
PROFESSIONAL MONITORING

Real-time stereo VU metering with peak hold
Clipping detection and indicators
Drop markers during recording to flag important moments
Monitor audio while recording
PLAYBACK

Variable speed playback from 0.5x to 2x
Scrub through recordings with precision
Jump to markers instantly
SMART STORAGE

Efficient file management with search and filtering
Sort by date, duration, size, or name
Star your favorite recordings
Add notes to any recording
Share via AirDrop, Files, or cloud services
Perfect For:

Musicians recording rehearsals and demos
Podcasters capturing interviews on location
Field recordists and sound designers
Journalists and content creators
Anyone who refuses to compromise on audio quality
Why Lossless Matters:
Compressed formats like MP3 and AAC throw away audio data to save space. Once it's gone, you can't get it back. Meret records the full, uncompressed signal -- preserving every detail for editing, mixing, or archiving.

Download Meret and start recording with zero compromise.

quotes.text:
Meret – iOS audio recorder with WiFi transfer, no cloud, no account ($9.99)

I wanted a simple recorder that let me get files off my phone without AirDrop, iCloud, or signing up for anything. Everything I tried either needed a subscription or uploaded my recordings somewhere.

Meret does three things: records audio, stores it locally, lets you pull files over WiFi from any browser on the same network. That's it.

One-time $9.99. No account. No cloud. No subscription.
